name: Capture Enemy Outpost
description: Score 2 VP if you control one or more objective markers that were in your opponent's deployment zone at the start of the battle. Score 4 VP instead if you control two or more such objective markers.

name: Engage on All Fronts
description: Score 2 VP if you have one or more units fully within 3 or more different table quarters, and no table quarter contains any enemy units. Score 4 VP if you have one or more units fully within all 4 table quarters, and no table quarter contains any enemy units.

name: Establish Locus
description: Score 2 VP if you control the objective marker closest to the centre of the battlefield. Score 4 VP instead if you control the objective marker closest to the centre of the battlefield and at least one other objective marker.

name: Extend Battle Lines
description: Score 2 VP if you have one or more units in your opponent's deployment zone. Score 4 VP instead if you have two or more units in your opponent's deployment zone.

name: Behind Enemy Lines
description: Score 2 VP if you have one or more units wholly within your opponent's deployment zone. Score 4 VP if you have two or more units wholly within your opponent's deployment zone.

name: Secure No Man's Land
description: Score 2 VP if you control one or more objective markers that are not in either player's deployment zone. Score 4 VP if you control two or more objective markers that are not in either player's deployment zone.

name: Area Denial
description: Score 2 VP if there are no enemy units within your deployment zone (excluding your opponent's units that were set up in your deployment zone as part of that unit's Reserve rules). Score 4 VP if there are no enemy units within 6" of your deployment zone boundary (same exception applies).

name: Cull the Horde
description: Score 2 VP if 6 or more enemy models were destroyed this turn. Score 4 VP if 10 or more enemy models were destroyed this turn.

name: Assassinate
description: Score 2 VP if one or more enemy Character models were destroyed this turn. Score 4 VP if two or more enemy Character models were destroyed this turn.

name: Bring It Down
description: Score 2 VP if one or more enemy Monster or Vehicle models were destroyed this turn. Score 4 VP if two or more enemy Monster or Vehicle models were destroyed this turn.

name: Recover Assets
description: Score 2 VP if you control one or more objective markers. Score 4 VP if you control two or more objective markers.

name: Deploy Teleport Homer
description: Score 2 VP if one or more units from your army that have the Infiltrators or Scout special rule are within 6" of the centre of the battlefield. Score 4 VP if two or more such units are within 6" of the centre.

name: Cleanse
description: Score 2 VP if one or more units from your army that are in your opponent's deployment zone control one or more objective markers. Score 4 VP if two or more units from your army in your opponent's deployment zone each control an objective marker.

name: No Prisoners
description: Score 2 VP if any enemy units were destroyed this turn. Score 4 VP if three or more enemy units were destroyed this turn.

name: Overwhelming Force
description: Score 2 VP if all models in an enemy unit were destroyed by attacks made by models from a single unit from your army this turn. Score 4 VP if all models in two or more enemy units were each destroyed by attacks made by models from a single unit from your army this turn.

name: Take and Hold
description: Score 2 VP if you control more objective markers than your opponent at the end of your turn. Score 4 VP instead if you control 3 or more objective markers and more than your opponent.
